description: The data of a new message in the inbox. Each mail connector sends this data. The event text has the subject and the start of the body.

id.description: The id of the message. Give it to read, thread, reply, or the inbox actions.

from.description: The sender, with the name and the address.

date.description: When the message was sent, as RFC 3339.

message_id.description: The Message-ID header of the message. It is empty when the message has no Message-ID.

thread_id.description: The conversation of the message. Give it to thread.

snippet.description: The start of the body as text, at most 500 characters.

body.description: The full text of the message, at most 32768 bytes. It is the plain text part, or the HTML part as text when there is no plain text part.

body_truncated.description: True when the text of the message is longer than body.

has_attachments.description: True when the message has attachments.

size.description: The size of the message in bytes.
